title: Gift estimator
description: A guide to the custom, not a rule: from three questions about a guest household you see the range of money gift that is customary.

private.title: For your eyes only
private.body: What you work out and keep here is seen only by you, from your account. It is not shown to the other organisers, to guests, in exports or to connected assistants. It is free and will stay free.
